Make It Matter acknowledges the Dharawal people as the Traditional Custodians of the land on which we live and work, and pays respect to their Elders past, present and emerging. We also acknowledge the many First Nations peoples across Australia whose deep and continuing care for Country has shaped the communities and traditions that inspire the ways we craft and share with others.
